Hymn 47: We Will Sing of Zion
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major
Composer: Israel Ivins
Lyricist/Text Author: Israel Ivins
Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 47 titled "We Will Sing of Zion" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Israel Ivins and the lyrics were written by Israel Ivins.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
